messages:
oncall-bot Alert: High error rate on /v1/stream (5xx/timeouts) — 15m sustained, p50 latency up 3x, spike in client disconnects. Paging @alex (oncall) and @maria (eng-sre). Please acknowledge and triage.

alex Acknowledged. Looking now — switching to incident channel for live debugging.

maria I’m seeing a pattern: a lot of upstream 502/504 from the inference gateway when chunked responses are active. Client cancellations also increased ~2.2x.

sam Any deploys in the last 30m?

deploy-bot Deploy: service-inference v3.14.2 rolled at 1769876160 by lisa — healthchecks passed.

alex OK that aligns. Roll timeframe lines up with onset. Can someone pull streaming gateway logs (nginx+proxy) and runtime logs for the replica set?

tanya Grabbing gateway logs now. Tail shows repeated: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`, and chunked encoding aborts.

maria Runtime (inference) logs show many KV cache eviction warnings but no OOMs. GPU utilization normal. There are spikes in time-to-first-chunk (TTFC) for longer prompts.

alex Is it only long prompts or all streaming requests?

maria Mostly long prompts (>1k tokens) and chat sessions with many turns. Short generation streaming looks okay.

sam Could be the new batching heuristic from v3.14.2 — it extended request timeouts to try to batch more aggressively. If a client disconnects while batching, it may cause upstream to close.

alex Action: temporarily disable the aggressive batching changes on the gateway path to see if error rate drops. maria, prepare a rollback or quick config toggle.

maria I can flip batching back to the conservative profile via a feature flag in the control plane. Pushing change to canary now.

deploy-bot FeatureFlag:streaming_batching_profile -> conservative (canary) by maria at 1769876282.

lisa Canary updated to 1 pod. Monitoring...

(t+2m) maria Canary shows immediate drop in 502/504 on that pod, TTFC improved.

alex Good. Promote to all: maria, roll to all gateway nodes and inference proxies. Also set upstream keepalive to higher value for a short window.

maria Rolling to 8/8 gateway nodes. Also increasing nginx proxy_read_timeout from 60s -> 120s for streaming upstreams. Doing a staged rollout.

sam Noted customer impact: support tickets flagged timeouts from streaming clients (websocket + chunked HTTP). We should alert CS and add guidance to temporary workaround: set client reconnect/backoff and optionally disable streaming for affected flows.

lisa Pushing nginx timeout change to all nodes now.

(t+6m) deploy-bot FeatureFlag rolled to prod at 1769876405 by maria. nginx changed on 6/6 nodes at 1769876428 by lisa.

alex Monitoring error rate. Observed 60% reduction in 5xx within 90s of full rollout. Disconnects down ~55%.

maria We're still seeing a small tail of errors — digging into the inference runtime's chunked flushing path. There are intermittent EPIPEs when writing chunks to the proxy socket. That suggests the proxy is dropping connections in some cases (likely due to closed client sockets).

alex Hypothesis: some clients cancel early and the batching heuristic holds request context waiting to flush; when cancel arrives, runtime aborts write which leads to upstream 502. We need graceful cancellation handling to avoid surfacing 5xx. Short-term mitigation: return 200 with a small terminator chunk on cancellation instead of 5xx, or immediate abort handling at gateway returning 499 (client closed) rather than 502.

sam Can the gateway translate closed client connections into 499 instead of 502? That would de-escalate alerts and avoid counting as server errors.

maria Gateway already emits 499 when it detects client disconnect BEFORE proxying upstream, but if upstream closes first we see 502. We need to ensure upstream closure due to client cancel is classified as client cancel. That requires propagating disconnect signals quickly.

alex Immediate steps: 1) add a short TTL on batching buffers (100ms) to reduce window for client cancels to interrupt in-flight flushes, 2) adjust proxy to favor mapping upstream EPIPE -> 499 when possible, 3) long-term: add cancellation propagation and non-fatal write paths.

maria Implementing TTL change and mapping in gateway config now. I’ll also add a metric for EPIPEs mapped to 499s so we can see if classification improves.

lisa TTL updated to 100ms (canary) at 1769876531. Gateway classification rule added (canary) at 1769876540.

(t+3m) alex Observed another customer: heavy streaming client that cancels on interactive UX. We should reach out to product to recommend client backoff. sam, can you draft a short note to CS?

sam On it. Draft: "We're seeing elevated streaming disconnects after a recent batching tweak. Short-term mitigations applied; recommend clients implement exponential backoff and consider non-streaming fallback for long generations." Will post to support queue.

maria Canary metrics: EPIPEs dropped by 72% when TTL applied. Upstream 502s trending down to baseline.

alex Nice. Promote TTL+mapping to prod and keep extra timeouts for 15 minutes then revert if stable.

maria Promoting to prod now. Rolling to 8/8 at 1769876648.

deploy-bot ConfigRoll: batching_ttl=100ms + epipe_map499=true at 1769876655 by maria.

(t+10m) Current state: 5xx rate back to within SLO for most routes. Streaming disconnects reduced. No new deploys planned until incident is closed.

sam Logged customers affected: acct-8345, acct-2099 — CS notified and provided mitigations.

lisa Recommend we add a temporary alert suppression rule for /v1/stream 5xx spike to avoid paging on expected transient errors during the next 30m window while we validate. alex OK to suppress?

alex We'll suppress noisy paging but keep dashboards and pager escalation on SSE of >3x baseline sustained 10m. Set suppression-window 30m.

maria Opening a follow-up ticket: INF-STREAM-487 — root cause analysis to add cancellation propagation, less aggressive batching heuristics by default, and improved upstream error classification. Assign to eng-runtime and eng-gateway.

alex Also add a postmortem once we finish RCA and customer communications. Owners: maria (gateway), sam (oncall coordination), lisa (deploys). ETA 72h for draft.

sam Acknowledged. I'll coordinate CS updates and close support loop for affected customers once we confirm stability for 1h.

lisa One more note: I observed a backend process (cache compaction) overlapping with canary window earlier; not sure that's related but logging it in the ticket.

maria Good catch—adding compaction overlap as a contributing factor in the ticket for investigation.

alex Thanks everyone. I'll mark incident as mitigated for now — continue to watch for 30m and update thread. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot Incident mitigated: /v1/stream error spike reduced to baseline at 1769876890. Monitoring continues.

(t+25m) maria Final check: no regression, metrics stable. Moving to post-incident review.

alex Closing live incident channel. Postmortem link will be posted when ready.

lisa Thanks team.

sam Closing loop with CS and adding note to status page for affected customers."
